name: Relcovaptan
summary: Relcovaptan (SR-49059) is a non-peptide vasopressin receptor antagonist, selective for the V1A subtype. It has shown positive initial results for the treatment of Raynaud syndrome and dysmenorrhoea, and as a tocolytic, although it is not yet approved for clinical use.

pharmacology.text: Relcovaptan (SR-49059) is a non-peptide vasopressin receptor antagonist, selective for the V1A subtype.

uses.text: It has shown positive initial results for the treatment of Raynaud syndrome and dysmenorrhoea, and as a tocolytic, although it is not yet approved for clinical use.

fact.en: Relcovaptan blocks the V1A receptor for vasopressin, a hormone that narrows blood vessels and helps the kidneys hold on to water.
fact.zh: Relcovaptan 阻斷血管加壓素的 V1A 受體，這種荷爾蒙會使血管收縮，並幫助腎臟保留水分。
fact.zhHans: Relcovaptan 阻断血管加压素的 V1A 受体，这种荷尔蒙会使血管收缩，并帮助肾脏保留水分。
